auth.title: Sign in to FerroMQ
auth.subtitle: Use the dashboard username and password. The session is stored in an HttpOnly cookie — passwords are never saved in the browser.
auth.tokenHint: Static http_bearer_token (admin) or a created API key secret (fmqk_…).
auth.hint: Session lives in the HttpOnly cookie. Only an optional Bearer token is kept in sessionStorage.
auth.empty: Enter a username and password, or a Bearer token.
auth.invalid: Authentication failed. Check username, password, or token.
auth.unreachable: Cannot reach FerroMQ HTTP API at /api/v1.
auth.init: Initialize admin account from broker config
auth.initOk: Created {{username}}. You can sign in now.
auth.readonlyHint: Viewer accounts cannot kick clients, publish messages, load plugins, or write configuration.
auth.adminOnlyHint: Users, API keys, the audit log, broker config writes, secret reveal, and private-target connectivity tests are available to admin accounts.
auth.changePasswordHint: Updates the current session user. The new password is stored as a bcrypt hash on the broker.
auth.changePasswordUnavailable: Password change requires a session login.
auth.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters.

common.historyUnavailable: History storage is not enabled on this broker.

errors.tooManyRequests: Too many login attempts. Try again later.

list.truncated: Result truncated ({{count}} rows on this page). The broker set X-Truncated or format=page has_more.

features.unavailableHint: This cluster does not enable {{feature}}. The matching nav item is disabled.
features.sessionStorageHint: Offline clients need session storage; the list may be empty.

cluster.partial: {{count}} node(s) unreachable; results may be incomplete.

overview.title: Overview
overview.desc: Live cluster stats, metrics, and node health from /api/v1.
overview.noHistory: No history series yet. Enable storage in ferromq-http-api.toml.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.desc: Broker nodes, health checks, and feature support matrix.

clients.title: Clients
clients.desc: Search online and offline sessions, inspect detail, kick connections.
clients.kickConfirm: Kick client {{id}}? The connection and session will be closed.
clients.kickOfflinesConfirm: Kick all offline clients matching the current filters?

retains.title: Retained messages
retains.desc: Query retained messages and delete by exact topic.

publish.title: Publish
publish.desc: Publish an MQTT message through POST /mqtt/publish.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.desc: Cluster plugin inventory. Load, unload, reload, and edit plugin config JSON.
plugins.immutableHint: Immutable plugins cannot be stopped. Config writes still land on disk and need a process restart.

config.editorHint: JSON is written as the plugin TOML file. Secret keys stay redacted unless an admin reveals them.
config.pluginDesc: Node {{node}} · {{name}}. Validate before save. Diff is shown when the API returns one.
config.revealAdminOnly: Secrets stay redacted. Only admins can reveal.
config.noSecrets: No secret keys in this document
config.jsonObject: Config must be a JSON object
config.versionsHint: Newest backups first. Rollback restores the file.
config.rollbackConfirm: Restore version {{version}}? The current file is backed up first.
config.confirmHint: The API returned this dry-run result. Confirm to write the file.
config.diffEmpty: No field-level diff (or the API omitted one).

effectiveHint.hot: Already applied in this process via the plugin load_config hook. This is not a ferromqd restart.
effectiveHint.reload: File is on disk. Call reload (or save with apply=reload) so the plugin picks it up.
effectiveHint.restart_required: File is on disk. The running process will not use it until ferromqd restarts.

config.strippedSecrets: Omitted {{count}} redacted secret field(s) from the payload so they are not written as ***.
config.redactedSaveWarn: Secret fields still show ***. They are stripped on save so the file is not overwritten with stars. Ask an admin to Reveal if this plugin must keep those keys in a full rewrite.
config.viewerReadonly: Your role can read this config but cannot validate, save, or roll back.
config.aclHint: Prefer the ACL page for structured rules. This editor still writes ferromq-acl.toml as raw JSON.

brokerConfig.title: Broker config
brokerConfig.desc: Read ferromq.toml mqtt / listener / log. Writes update the file only and always require a process restart.
brokerConfig.restartHint: Saving mqtt, listener, or log never hot-restarts ferromqd. The new file is used on the next process start.
brokerConfig.readHint: Everyone can read this overview. Only admins can write sections, roll back, or reveal secrets.
brokerConfig.listenerHint: Listener tables are nested (tcp/ssl/ws). Edit the JSON object; unknown keys are kept on merge.

users.title: Users
users.desc: Dashboard accounts. Admin only. Passwords are never listed.
users.createHint: Password is stored as a bcrypt hash on the broker. Minimum 8 characters.

apikeys.title: API keys
apikeys.desc: Hashed Bearer keys for automation. The secret is shown once on create.
apikeys.listHint: Listed keys never include the secret. Use Authorization: Bearer <secret>.
apikeys.name: Name
apikeys.createHint: Role defaults to operator. The plaintext secret is returned only once.
apikeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke API key {{id}}? It will stop working immediately.
apikeys.secretHint: This value is shown once and stored as SHA-256. It will not appear again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.desc: Newest first. In-memory ring buffer on this node; optional audit_file JSONL.

integrations.missingHint: No {{plugin}} TOML on this node yet. Adding an item writes the file via the P5 API.

acl.title: ACL
acl.desc: Structured ferromq-acl rules. Writes hot-apply via plugin load_config when the plugin is loaded.
acl.topicsHint: One filter per line. Prefix with = for exact match ({ eq }).
acl.formHint: Who is "all" or a match object. Passwords stay *** unless an admin reveals them; redacted values are omitted on save.
acl.settingsHint: disconnect_if_pub_rejected and priority live in ferromq-acl.toml.
acl.deleteConfirm: Delete rule #{{index}}? The remaining rules keep their new indexes after a hot apply.

authProviders.title: MQTT auth providers
authProviders.desc: Configure ferromq-auth-http and ferromq-auth-jwt. These authenticate MQTT clients, not dashboard login.
authProviders.editorHint: PUT writes the plugin TOML via P4 and hot-applies with load_config when possible.
authProviders.kindHint_http: External HTTP auth / ACL. Test is a TCP connect after SSRF checks — no HTTP request is sent.
authProviders.kindHint_jwt: Local HMAC secret or public-key file. Test does not call an IdP.
authProviders.testUrlHint: Optional. Defaults to http_auth_req.url then http_acl_req.url.

rewrites.title: Auto-subscribe / topic rewrite
rewrites.desc: Indexed CRUD on ferromq-auto-subscription and ferromq-topic-rewrite.

autoSub.title: Auto-subscribe
autoSub.formHint: Clients receive these topic filters automatically after connect.

topicRewrite.title: Topic rewrite
topicRewrite.formHint: source_topic_filter must be unique. Optional regex rewrites dest_topic captures.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.desc: Default URLs and hook rules for ferromq-web-hook. URL userinfo is redacted unless an admin reveals it.
webhooks.settingsHint: queue_capacity and concurrency_limit need a plugin restart (plugin docs). Test is a TCP ping, not an HTTP POST.
webhooks.urlsHint: Used when a rule does not set its own urls.
webhooks.rulesHint: Each hook can have multiple rules with optional topic filters and override URLs.
webhooks.ruleHint: hook is the event name. action usually matches the hook.
webhooks.testHint: TCP connect only. Private / loopback hosts need allow_private=1 and an admin session.
webhooks.testUrlHint: Leave empty to use the first http(s) default URL.

bridges.title: Bridges
bridges.desc: Known and discovered ferromq-bridge-* plugins. Status comes from attrs() when loaded.
bridges.name: Plugin
bridges.configDesc: Write {{name}}.toml via P4. Load / unload call the plugin start/stop hooks.
bridges.saveHint: Confirm to write the bridge config file.

blacklist.title: Blacklist
blacklist.desc: FerroMQ does not ship a dedicated blacklist plugin. This page reports that gap from GET /blacklist.
blacklist.unavailableHint: There is no blacklist or connection-policy plugin in this tree. Use ACL deny + control=connect instead.
blacklist.alternativeHint: Use these P5 APIs instead of a dedicated blacklist.
